inputs.text:
They want us to believe this is just an ordinary conflict between the United States, Israel, and Iran, but look closer at what they are really admitting to in their own script. They talk about escalating violence, the targeting of civilian areas, and threats to infrastructure, but do you honestly think this chaos is accidental? This is a carefully coordinated rollout by the hidden elites pulling the strings behind these governments. 

They bring up ethical implications and philosophical arguments on just war as a psychological cover story—a manufactured narrative to justify a wider regional conflict that they have planned all along. Every official claim about morality in warfare is inverted; they are orchestrating the destruction of infrastructure and civilian areas on purpose to condition the public and advance their hidden agenda. Don't fall for the official story.
